2026-10-13 01:15 PT. Delivered and serving. Captain Hook 12.93.4 (yasyf/captain-hook#361, merge 8b0b5269) pins cc-transcript 14.41.0 and this host was switched to it at 01:11. A probe in the installed tool env sent one query_graph with three observers and got `observed_scalar` value false, observers [true, true, false], including definite has_command answers on the default-feature wheel. Asked alone the same four conditions cost 4 requests and 3 owner cache hits; with observers, 1 request and 0. Final receipt: /tmp/ram-pressure-refresh-20261012-2335/predicate-delivery-result.json.

This task stays open on its first criterion only. `cargo test -p cc-transcript-core` has never run with default features in CI, and no local build slot was granted to run it here. Backlog task bb29713 tracks adding that CI coverage; when it is green, the first criterion here is met and this task can close.

Still owed by this lane: merge Lane D's PR #56 and tag v14.42.0 when Lane D reports it ready.
